title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: Get ready to explore enhanced insights with the official launch of Spyglass, now available to everyone.

title: Elevated File Management for Your Content
summary: Take full command of your content with our new, intuitive file management system, allowing you to easily upload, link, download, and remove files, while also choosing how they visually appear within your editor.

summary: Discover our journey with the new public roadmap, providing a clear overview of recently shipped features, upcoming releases, and exciting future plans.

summary: We've transformed checkboxes to be more intuitive and visually appealing, making task management effortless with improved clickability and seamless drag-and-drop functionality.

summary: Experience seamless real-time teamwork and effortlessly collaborate with your team.

summary: Now you can effortlessly find and collaborate on shared ideas and quests, making teamwork smoother than ever.
